<title>riscv-privileged-20250508</title>
<section>Chapter 22. Control-flow Integrity (CFI) > 22.1. Landing Pad (Zicfilp) > 22.1.2. Preserving Expected Landing Pad State on Traps</section>
<previous>PECTED` .

Upon entry into Debug Mode, the `pelp` bit in `dcsr` is updated with the `ELP` at the privilege level the hart was previously in, and the `ELP` is set to `NO_LP_EXPECTED` . When a hart resumes from Debug Mode, if the new privilege mode is `y` , then `ELP` is set to the value of `pelp` if _`y`_ `LPE` (see Section 22.1.1) is 1; otherwise, it is set to `NO_LP_EXPECTED` .

See also Chapter 8 for semantics added to the RNMI trap and the MNRET instruction when this extension is implemented.</previous>
<target>_The trap handler in privilege mode_ `x` _must save the_ _`x`_ `PELP` _bit and the_ `x7` _register before performing an indirect call/jump if_ `xLPE=1` _. If the privilege mode_ `x` _can respond to interrupts and_ `xLPE=1` _, then the trap handler should also save these values before enabling interrupts._ 

_The trap handler in privilege mode_ `x` _must restore the saved_ _`x`_ `PELP` _bit and the_ `x7` _register before executing the_ _`x`_ `RET` _instruction to return from a trap._</target>
